# HLS.js

`hls.light.min.js`: HLS.js 1.6.13, vendored from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.6.13/dist/hls.light.min.js.

Project: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js. Apache-2.0 license: `hls.LICENSE`.

Used by station preview and watch pages. Worker mode is disabled to match the existing app Content Security Policy. No CDN script access is required for users.
